verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform, so per-number business hours are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents business hours, open/closed schedules, or holiday behavior. The adjacent routing features it does show (custom ring orders, phone menus, call transfers, Sona answering when the team can't) are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
